name: lunarplanb
description: Build step for the 3D view only. The bundle it writes (site/js/view3d.bundle.js) is committed, so publishing needs no install.

scripts.build3d: esbuild web3d/view3d.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* Lunar Plan B 3D view. Contains three.js r187 (MIT licence, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js), only the parts used. Source: web3d/view3d.js */" --outfile=site/js/view3d.bundle.js
